svg.aria-label: How Screencast Director goes from recording to edit. Press Control-Option-Command-R in any app and it records your screen, mic and camera, plus a log of when you clicked and typed; Control-Option-Command-M marks a retake. When you stop, whisper.cpp transcribes you on your Mac, and the draft edit plays talking in real time, speeds up typing, cuts silence, filler words and retakes, zooms where you clicked and adds captions. The edit is one plan file, and you change it on the timeline by hand or by asking Claude Code, the Anthropic API or any OpenAI-compatible model.
